annotations.title: Link to share an Uber or Lyft (Cabpool)

description: Cabpool: a free Seat Sherpa feature for sharing an Uber, Lyft or Waymo with people going the same way and splitting the fare, most often to or from an airport (SFO, OAK, SJC, LAX, BUR, SAN, SMF and others) or across town in California or Nevada. Use it when the person wants to split a rideshare rather than ride in someone's car, including short trips inside one area (for example "split an Uber from Nob Hill to SFO"), which search_rides does not cover. Returns a link that opens the cabpool form with the pickup, drop-off and day filled in; the person signs in, sees a fare estimate and each person's share, and posts it so others going that way can join. Seat Sherpa does not book, run or charge for the ride and is not affiliated with Uber, Lyft or Waymo: one member books it in their own app and the others pay their share directly. This tool only builds the link and posts nothing.

date.description: Optional travel date, YYYY-MM-DD (Pacific). Today is 2026-11-05 (Pacific): use today or a later date, and when the person names a day without a year, the next one on or after today. Omit and the person picks the day on the page.

from.description: Pickup: a place, neighborhood, campus or airport, e.g. "Nob Hill, San Francisco", "UC Davis", "LAX".

time.description: Optional pickup time, 24-hour HH:MM Pacific (e.g. "06:30"); used only together with date.
